text:
Jordan: Quick decision thread for Optimize toolkit GA scope. Customers asked for batching/caching/quant recs + eval-triggered alerts. Need to pick GA behavior by EOD.
Priya: propose we GA with recommendation surface + alerting only (no auto-apply). keep rollout simple.
Diego: agree. also want to lock the fidelity checks for quant suggestions. we should codify them now.
Maya: Sales/customer asks: SlateBank wants opt-in auto-apply for low-risk rerank endpoints. MediSure requires manual approval + audit trail.
Lina: CS will only sign pilots if we provide weekly CSV exports of recs and eval summaries. also retention = 90 days for audit logs.
Jordan: draft GA must-haves: 1) Recommendations API (read-only) with rationale text 2) Eval-alert webhook + minimal UI alert inbox 3) Audit events + CSV export 4) Feature-flagged rollout and manual apply only for GA.
Priya: implementation notes: batching recs from runtime metrics (avg seq len, concurrent sessions) -> suggest batch_size and batching_window. caching recs need estimate of prefix reuse; we'll add a small profiler job.
Diego: quant pipeline: run a lightweight A/B fidelity job on a holdout: compute inst-level quality delta (ROUGE/EMBED sim) and aggregate median. thresholds: median quality delta <= 2% AND 95th-percentile token-mismatch < 4 tokens. failing flows flagged.
Maya: can you translate that into a customer-friendly phrasing? they want an easy yes/no.
Diego: Customer phrasing: "Quant suggestion passed local fidelity checks" or "Quant suggestion needs manual review (quality delta exceeded)".
Jordan: rollout controls: add `apply_mode` in config: `manual`|`opt_in`|`auto` but GA = `manual`.
Priya: alerting destinations: SRE->pager for infra regressions, CS->inbox for quality regressions. We need an alert schema that includes: service, model, rec_type, eval_metric, delta, eval_link.
Jordan: example alert payload?
Priya: ```
{
  "service": "re-ranker",
  "model": "ggml-v1-quant8",
  "rec_type": "quant",
  "metric": "embed_sim",
  "delta": 0.08,
  "eval_link": "https://evals.redwood/internal/123"
}
```
Lina: CS wants the CSV columns: timestamp, customer, endpoint, rec_type, old_config, suggested_config, rationale, eval_summary_link.
Maya: Pilot acceptance checklist (proposal):
- run canonical eval suite pre/post (pass/fail tags)
- verify CSV export matches sample
- run 1-week trial under 95th p99 load
- manual approval flow exercised
- audit logs visible and exportable
Jordan: timeline: ship feature-flagged API + eval hooks to staging in 2 weeks, run pilot kickoff week after. GA ready in 6 weeks if pilots pass.
Priya: engineering risk: quant-fidelity runs can be expensive. propose we sample 10% of traffic for fidelity checks in pilot to keep cost down.
Diego: sampling ok for pilot, but must require full-fidelity offline job before opt-in auto-apply.
Maya: customer asks re: visibility: they want the rationale text to include the eval metric and a short human-readable reason. e.g., "Reduced perf <1.5% on generation; recommend quant8 for latency win".
Priya: API contract stub I will drop later: `POST /recs` and `GET /recs?customer=...` plus `GET /recs/{id}/audit`
Jordan: decision vote: react with :thumbsup: for "manual-only GA, passive alerts" or :rocket: for "GA includes opt-in auto-apply".
Priya: :thumbsup:
Diego: :thumbsup:
Maya: :rocket: (big accounts want opt-in)
Lina: :thumbsup: (CS needs control)
Jordan: outcome: manual-only GA with opt-in auto-apply scoped for Q2 after pilot validation.
Jordan: action items: Priya to post API contract & timeline (action: priya/3d), Diego to finalize fidelity thresholds & provide a lightweight eval script (action: diego/1w), Maya/Lina to lock pilots with SlateBank + MediSure and share acceptance criteria with customers (action: maya/lina/1w), infra team to add alert routing and retention (action: eng-oncall/5d).
Priya: acknowledged. I'll add the feature-flag key `optimize_toolkit_v1` to our deploy plan.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy -> staging at 2024-04-20T03:30Z (flags: optimize_toolkit_v1=false)
Jordan: thanks all. I'll close this thread after API contract lands. Ping here for blockers.
Maya: dropping a short pilot runbook into #product-playbooks after I sync with Sales.
Lina: prepping customer email template that includes the weekly CSV example.
